bubble.purpose: The ADV band only. 16/26 is the ruling every other surface aligns to.

plate.purpose: The slanted parallelogram. Never used for running text.

caption.purpose: Hint strip and timestamps. Never the character.

shadows.name: shadow-popover
shadows.purpose: Chat and key windows. Fixed by addendum C5; dark uses .28/.20.

shadows.name: shadow-bubble
shadows.purpose: The ADV band. Dark uses .30/.20. Lives on the band element, never on the clipped fill layer - a clip-path would erase it.

shadows.name: shadow-hint
shadows.purpose: The hint strip, lighter than the band so it reads as a different layer. Dark uses .24/.18.

motion.name: dur-state
motion.purpose: In-place state change: plate tint, line weight.

motion.name: dur-blink
motion.purpose: The advance mark at 1 Hz. 0ms under reduced motion.

components.name: ADV Band
components.description: The character's message window. Click completes the reveal and opens the chat. SHIPPING FORM, normative: the 8-degree signature is contracts.md 5.5's .bubble__rail - a 3px --c-plate rail on the band's left edge, transform skewX(var(--adv-skew)), horizontal run var(--adv-cut) - which 5.5 pins as the ONE consumer of --adv-cut. Not a clip-path. The html/css below is the TOKEN SHEET's specimen, not a shipping recipe: it keeps a literal cut by moving the clip-path off the band root onto the .ds-band__surface fill layer, which is correct on a specimen board and is NOT sanctioned for bubble/, chat/ or key/. A bare clip-path on the band root is wrong everywhere - it erases --shadow-bubble and clips away the plate, which hangs above the band's top edge. The 460 below is likewise specimen-only: 460 x 320 is BUBBLE_MAX, the bubble WINDOW budget, and 24px of it is --shadow-bubble's room (contracts 5.2), so the shipping band element is inset from it.

components.css: .ds-band { position: relative; width: 460px; box-sizing: border-box; color: var(--c-bubble-text); border-radius: var(--r-bubble); box-shadow: var(--shadow-bubble); padding: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-5) var(--sp-5); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--fs-bubble); line-height: var(--lh-bubble); font-weight: var(--fw-line); } .ds-band__surface { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--c-bubble-surface); border-radius: var(--r-bubble); border-top: 1px solid var(--c-bubble-border); clip-path: polygon(var(--adv-cut) 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-band p { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin: 0; max-width: calc(24 * 1em); overflow-wrap: anywhere; line-break: strict; } .ds-plate { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: -20px; left: var(--sp-5); transform: skewX(var(--adv-skew)); background: var(--c-plate); color: var(--c-accent-text); border: 1px solid var(--c-border-strong); padding: 3px var(--sp-3); font-size: 13px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-plate span { display: inline-block; transform: skewX(calc(-1 * var(--adv-skew))); } .ds-advance { position: absolute; z-index: 1; right: var(--sp-4); bottom: var(--sp-2); color: var(--c-advance); font-size: 12px; }

components.description: The user's line, skinned as the same window with the plate reading 你.
components.css: .ds-composer { width: 360px; min-height: 48px; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--c-surface); color: var(--c-text); border: 1px solid var(--c-border); border-radius: var(--r-popover); box-shadow: var(--shadow-popover); padding: var(--sp-3); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--fs-body); line-height: var(--lh-body); } .ds-composer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Her words land in the box every ACG reader has read ten thousand lines in: a translucent band with a slanted name plate, typewriter reveal and a blinking advance mark. The box behaves like an ADV box — click to skip, flip to input mode when it is your line. It refuses the glass chat bubble with a tail, the toast, and the card. Light is warm paper; dark is ink navy. One accent, the character's own, carried entirely by the name plate.
keyCharacteristics: A 26 px line ruling for her voice, 22 px for yours.
One signature angle: the band's left edge cut at the plate's 8 degrees.
Emotion is material — the plate's tint and the line's weight — never a badge.
The band is placed off-axis so the character stands in its right third.
The system never speaks in her voice; it speaks on a separate hint strip.

rules.name: One Accent, One Owner
rules.body: The single accent belongs to the character and appears only on the name plate. Status colours are not accents.

rules.name: The 26 Ruling
rules.body: Her line is 16/26. Every surface that shares the screen with the band aligns to multiples of 26 or 22.

rules.name: One Angle
rules.body: Minus eight degrees is the entire non-rectilinear vocabulary. A second angle breaks the device.

rules.name: The Rail Is The Cut
rules.body: The 8-degree signature ships as contracts.md 5.5's .bubble__rail - a 3px skewed --c-plate rail, the one consumer of --adv-cut - and not as a clip-path. A clip-path on the band root erases --shadow-bubble and clips off the hanging name plate; the two-layer fill-layer cut that avoids that is the token sheet's specimen technique only. Rail (contracts 5.5) vs two-layer cut (craft floor) is an open ruling request to the controller; until it lands, 5.5 governs.

dos: Do read every colour, radius, duration and size from tokens.css.
Do put system messages on the hint strip.
Do keep the band off-axis, extending away from the character's body.
Do animate only transform and opacity.
donts: Don't add a tail, a pointer triangle, or a rounded speech balloon.
Don't use purple or indigo gradients, gradient text, or radial halos.
Don't signal emotion with a badge, an emoji or a coloured dot.
Don't invert the light palette to make dark.
Don't put the cut's clip-path on the band root, and don't lay the anchor notch on top of the band.
Don't ship the token sheet's two-layer fill-layer cut in bubble/, chat/ or key/ - contracts 5.5's .bubble__rail is the shipping form of the 8-degree signature.
Don't size the band element to 460 - that is the bubble window's budget and 24px of it is --shadow-bubble's room.
